feedback_reports_scores_range.name: feedback_reports_scores_range
feedback_reports_scores_range.value:
"feedback_reports"."grammar" between 0 and 100 and "feedback_reports"."vocabulary" between 0 and 100
        and "feedback_reports"."fluency" between 0 and 100 and "feedback_reports"."pronunciation_score" between 0 and 100
        and "feedback_reports"."overall_score" between 0 and 100

feedback_reports_ready_complete.name: feedback_reports_ready_complete
feedback_reports_ready_complete.value: "feedback_reports"."status" <> 'ready' or ("feedback_reports"."overall_score" is not null and "feedback_reports"."summary_json" is not null and "feedback_reports"."generated_at" is not null)

reports_review_complete.name: reports_review_complete
reports_review_complete.value: "reports"."status" not in ('actioned', 'dismissed') or ("reports"."reviewed_by" is not null and "reports"."reviewed_at" is not null)

sessions_ended_consistency.name: sessions_ended_consistency
sessions_ended_consistency.value: ("sessions"."status" = 'ended') = ("sessions"."ended_at" is not null and "sessions"."end_reason" is not null)
